table.specLine: The text box is pinned to the bottom. Served pages reserve 24px under the document for the build stamp (body padding-bottom: 24px).
Tab icons are vertically centered within their tab.
No element is wider than the viewport: document scrollWidth <= innerWidth, and each element's right <= innerWidth. Half a pixel is float rounding only.
The header sits at the top of the viewport.
The footer sits at the document end. A logo floating mid-page fails.
The conversation list sits between the header and the text box. The vacation website sits on top, and the control slider sits in the middle, above the text box.
With 0 or 1 vacations the header is absent or its height is 0. An empty header bar fails. Website full-screen: the website fills the viewport.
